description: This source file defines the ActivationLifetime class, which manages the lifecycle and deactivation locking for grains within Orleans transactions. It implements lifecycle observation interfaces and provides methods for starting, stopping, and blocking deactivation.

classes.name: ActivationLifetime
classes.description: Manages activation lifecycle, including handling deactivation locks and observing lifecycle stages.

methods.name: ActivationLifetime
methods.description: Constructor that subscribes to lifecycle stages.

methods.name: OnDeactivating
methods.description: Property exposing a cancellation token that signals deactivation.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles activation start; currently a no-op.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles activation stop, cancels deactivation tokens and waits for ongoing deactivations to finish.

methods.name: OnStopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous wait loop to ensure in-flight deactivations complete within a timeout period.

methods.name: BlockDeactivation
methods.description: Provides an IDisposable that, when disposed, releases a deactivation lock.

classes.name: BlockDeactivationDisposable
classes.description: Inner class that manages a deactivation lock via IDisposable pattern.
